needs.reason: The source returned a sign-in wall instead of its content

errors.message: The source returned a sign-in wall instead of its content

needs_user_action.question: This page needs a signed-in session or a verification step before its player exposes the real source. Sign the user in once from the chat: envoy_auth action open shows the site's own sign-in page and the link reads normally afterwards.

credential_handoff.how_to_enable: Importing cookies from another browser is off. The user can enable it once with `envoy auth handoff on` (or ENVOY_CREDENTIAL_HANDOFF=1 for one shell); signing in from the chat works without it.

options.instruction: Call envoy_auth with action open and this source_url; it returns a picture of the site's sign-in page (usually the QR code) to show the user. They scan once, the browser stays in the background, and this link reads normally once envoy_auth status reports signed_in.
options.effect: The user signs in once from the chat, without a terminal, and Envoy's isolated profile keeps the session

options.instruction: From a terminal, read this page once with visible browser mode enabled and complete the normal sign-in there; the session is kept in ~/.envoy/browser-profile and reused by later headless reads.
options.effect: One sign-in at the user's terminal keeps the local browser profile usable for later headless reads
